build_entry: owner_probe.cpp (includes raw_owner_cases.cc and exact fixed-operation worker)

known_reds_counted_as_expected.NOFILE_0_remains_EMFILE_known_red: native fstat/statfs succeed but worker Read remains -1/EMFILE24

wait_scope: Only own fork PIDs; SIGCHLD=DFL and no SA_NOCLDWAIT prerequisite; PDEATHSIG on owned descendants; ECHILD never authorizes kill. Direct/nested started and reaped counts separate from assertions.
worker: Fixed stat/statfs/fcntl-seals/owned-user-xattr snapshot. Pure x86_64 raw clone trampoline and raw syscall worker; no arbitrary callback or libc/TLS use in child closure.
independent_fdtable: CLONE_FILES omitted; close_range operates only on worker copied table. PIDFD_THREAD+pidfd_getfd bind each request to its actual caller TID.
exit_lifetime: Stop waits kernel clear_child_tid using shared FUTEX_WAIT before stack reuse.
known_limits: Full provenance/root-factory identity and projection are not integrated or tested.
Raw private fork under AS1 is tested with active idle owner; deterministic in-flight request fork is not covered.
NOFILE0 remains EMFILE; task-count/kernel memory failures remain possible.
Worker is not Bionic-pthread-registered. It must never remain alive across application credential/root/mount/capability transitions or zygote stop/fork boundaries.
Independent FD table does not isolate credentials. No prewarmed root worker may enter an app credential generation.
Host cancellation, Bionic thread broadcasts, foreign CLONE_VM callers, runtime/zygote/exec/last-thread retirement hooks are not qualified by this suite.
Existing ordinary alias-to-maps admission race is unchanged.
